title: Attribution of Summer 2025 Heatwaves: A Multi-Model Ensemble
audience: NeurIPS Climate & ML workshop — climate scientists and ML researchers
core_points: research question: to what extent are 2025 NH summer heatwaves attributable to anthropogenic forcing?
related work positioning: Stott et al. 2004, Otto et al. 2020, IPCC AR6 WG1 Ch.11 — how our approach differs
data: 18 CMIP6 models, ERA5 reanalysis 1950-2025, HadCRUT5 observations
method: ensemble optimal fingerprinting with regularized EOFs; details in 4 equations
dense results table: 6 regions x attribution fraction + 95% CI + p-value
regional comparison: Europe vs North America vs East Asia side-by-side
model disagreement deep-dive: 8 bullet points on variance sources
timeline: data release 2026 Q1 -> code release Q2 -> follow-up paper Q4
limitations: 9 bullets covering model biases, observational uncertainty, regional resolution, stationarity assumptions
conclusion quote from lead author about societal implications
acknowledgements and funding footer, then Q&A
